dialogues.speaker: Anonymous Message
dialogues.text: #"Forging an Ancient Name is an arduous task, but earnest hearts shall grant {M#him}{F#her} their blessing."

dialogues.speaker: Anonymous Message
dialogues.text: "Each sacrifice will be acknowledged by the Wayob, every act of Devotion will be remembered by the Night Kingdom."

dialogues.speaker: Anonymous Message
dialogues.text: #"The memories of {M#his}{F#her} companions give {M#him}{F#her} {M#his}{F#her} name, and the traces of {M#his}{F#her} journey tell {M#his}{F#her} story."
